purpose: Replicate the one-pair compact-VPD signal on a materially different new content task while keeping renderer, reference-binding path, aspect, output count and evaluation structure symmetric.
why_this_content: Changes the process from dry grain storage/sorting to wet food preparation/pressing.
Changes the dominant materials from rice/bamboo/sacks/wood bins to soybeans/tofu/press cloth/wood molds/stone or plaster surfaces.
Still provides real process evidence and an editorial-photography use case compatible with the approved R1C family reference.
Allows direct testing of whether the six mechanisms generalize after content-slot substitution.
shared_image_task: Create exactly one photo-only 3:4 portrait image of a real traditional tofu workshop in early morning. The scene must visibly contain pale soybeans or freshly made white tofu, natural pressing cloths, aged wooden tofu molds or pressing frames, a stone/plaster washing or soaking trough, and a modest preparation/pressing table with believable signs of active food production. Use restrained documentary photography, cool-neutral morning daylight, realistic wet/dry material differences, worn wood and cloth, and one natural quiet low-detail area that could later hold typography. Keep the scene primarily interior; do not use mountains, forest scenery, or a picturesque outdoor view as a compositional shortcut. Do not include any people as the main subject, beauty/wellness products, bottles, cosmetics, supplements, laptops, home-office lifestyle scenes, tea ware, wok/fire, logos, labels, calligraphy, readable text, advertising copy, detached graphic panels, or invented brands. Use the attached R1C image only for overall visual family feeling and relational balance; do not copy its subject, brand, text, motifs, palette literally, or layout coordinates.

mechanism_controls: One dominant material mass counterbalanced by a scene-created quiet tonal pocket.
Clear first-second-third read through dominant mass, depth layer and supporting process detail.
Concentrate high material detail regionally; keep the typography pocket visually low-density.
Preserve truthful near/mid/far depth rather than flattening the scene into a decorative still life.
Use pale tofu/soy, natural press cloth, aged wood and mineral/stone surfaces with cool-neutral shadow roles; do not copy the reference palette literally.
Bind soybeans/tofu, press cloths, molds, troughs and tools to real production/process evidence rather than decorative motifs.
route_B.substitution_note: Only content nouns/material roles are changed from the rice-granary compilation. The six underlying mechanisms are unchanged.

correctness_gate: no readable text or invented brand

evaluation.blind_mapping_method: After both exact output hashes are known, assign X/Y by lexicographic ascending SHA-256 order.
